Legal purpose: Subscription Agreement - Establishes the terms of the investment
Liquidity Provisions - Specifies the frequency of redemption
Governing Law - Determines the jurisdiction for legal disputes
Signatory Requirements - Ensures valid electronic signatures
Accredited Investor - Confirms the investor's status and understanding

Morning, Sakura Life Insurance Co., a insurer, is committing US$50m to the flagship fund and needs a side letter. As a US pension plan they need a representation about ERISA plan assets. Many thanks. Priya (Sales)
Legal purpose: Representation and Warranty - Ensures compliance with ERISA for plan assets
Side Letter - Provides additional terms for the specific investor, Sakura Life Insurance Co.

Dear Legal, We won a discretionary SGD fixed income mandate from Temasek Road Endowment, a university endowment, roughly S$60m. Please draft the IMA. They are restructuring and want to be able to move the contract to a group entity. They want a clause allocating any carbon credits generated by portfolio companies to them. Cheers. Mei Ling (IR)
Legal purpose: Group Entity Assignment - Permits transfer of contract to a group entity.
Carbon Credit Allocation - Allocates carbon credits generated by portfolio companies to the university endowment.

Hi Legal, Could you prepare an NDA with Lion City Wealth Partners (an independent wealth manager)? We are discussing a joint product discussion. They don't want arbitration - disputes should go to the Singapore courts. They are restructuring and want to be able to move the contract to a group entity. Appreciate it. Priya (Sales)
Legal purpose: Non-dispute resolution - Specifies jurisdiction for court disputes.

Assignment and transfer - Allows contract movement to group entities.

Hello team, New subscription from Clementi Holdings Pte. Ltd. (investment holding company) for about S$20m into the Asia Income Fund. Please prepare the subscription agreement. The subscriber is a statutory pension board, not an individual accredited investor. Notices by courier are impractical for them, email should be enough. Please switch dispute resolution to litigation in Singapore instead of SIAC. Thanks! Arjun (Distribution)
Legal purpose: Dispute Resolution - Specifies that disputes shall be resolved through litigation in the courts of Singapore.

Morning, Nordic Public Pension Fund, a pension fund, is committing US$200m to the flagship fund and needs a side letter. They'd like to be offered deals alongside the fund when we have them. They want comfort that no one else of their size gets a better deal than them. Many thanks. Priya (Sales)
Legal purpose: Non-dilution - Ensures that the investor receives the agreed terms and conditions.

Non-superior terms - Ensures that no other investor receives more favorable terms.

Hi, Could you prepare an NDA with Raffles Pension Trustees (a pension consultant)? We are discussing a potential seed investment in our new fund. This should be unilateral - they receive, we don't. Thanks in advance. Sarah (PM team)
Legal purpose: Non-disclosure of confidential information - prohibits the recipient from disclosing sensitive information to third parties.

Unilateral confidentiality - specifies that the recipient receives confidential information but does not provide any.

Hi Legal, KL Capital Distributors Sdn Bhd (Malaysian placement agent) wants to distribute our Pan-Asia Equity VCC. Can we get a distribution agreement going? Please put a ceiling on our exposure under the contract tied to the fees. Please confirm we can execute it electronically. Many thanks. Sarah (PM team)
Legal purpose: Distribution Agreement - Establishes the terms for the distribution relationship.
Fee Cap - Limits the maximum exposure to fees.
Electronic Execution - Permits the execution of the contract electronically.

Hello team, Could you prepare an NDA with Lion City Wealth Partners (an independent wealth manager)? We are discussing sharing data for a mandate pitch. Please switch dispute resolution to litigation in Singapore instead of SIAC. Make sure we're free to share with our regulator without needing to notify the other side. Thanks! Sarah (PM team)
Legal purpose: Dispute Resolution - Provides for resolution of disputes through litigation in Singapore.

Confidentiality - Ensures the sharing of data remains confidential.

Regulatory Compliance - Allows for sharing with regulators without notifying the other party.

Dear Legal, Could you prepare an NDA with Marina Bay Securities Ltd (a broker)? We are discussing a possible fund distribution arrangement. Counterparty will only sign if the agreement is under the law of England and Wales. They asked for a carve-out for general know-how their staff retain from memory. Cheers. Sarah (PM team)
Legal purpose: Jurisdiction Clause - Specifies the governing law of the agreement.

Confidentiality Obligations - Protects confidential information shared between the parties.

Carve-out for General Know-How - Excludes certain information from the scope of confidentiality.

Morning, New subscription from Changi Reinsurance Ltd (reinsurer) for about S$0.5m into the Asia Income Fund. Please prepare the subscription agreement. They will sign on DocuSign, so make sure that's valid. Liquidity terms should be quarterly, not monthly. Cheers. Priya (Sales)
Legal purpose: Subscription Agreement - Establishes the terms for the subscription of shares or units.  
Liquidity Provisions - Specifies the frequency and conditions for redemption or withdrawal.

Hi Legal, Gulf Sovereign Investment Authority, a sovereign wealth fund, is committing US$25m to the flagship fund and needs a side letter. The client's board has a policy against coal and weapons, so those must stay out of what we manage for them. As an insurer they must report to their regulator and need us to supply fund data on request. Thanks! Daniel (Ops)
Legal purpose: Non-investment in prohibited sectors - excludes investments in coal and weapons.

Data reporting obligations - requires provision of fund data upon request.

Hi, Nordic Public Pension Fund, a pension fund, is committing US$200m to the flagship fund and needs a side letter. Give them a narrower MFN that excludes fee and co-invest terms. They'd like to be offered deals alongside the fund when we have them. They may move the holding to another entity in their group and don't want to ask permission. Appreciate it. Kenji (Product)
Legal purpose: Non-dilution - Ensures the investor's ownership percentage is not reduced without their consent.

Co-investment rights - Grants the investor the right to participate in certain investments.

Transfer restrictions - Limits the ability to transfer investments without the fund manager's consent.

Morning, Could you prepare an NDA with Harbourfront Capital Pte. Ltd. (a family office)? We are discussing a potential seed investment in our new fund. They asked for a carve-out for general know-how their staff retain from memory. Thanks in advance. Sarah (PM team)
Legal purpose: Carve-out for general know-how - permits the retention and use of general knowledge and skills by the recipient's personnel.

Hi Legal, Could you prepare an NDA with Tanjong Analytics Pte. Ltd. (a data vendor)? We are discussing a potential seed investment in our new fund. Two years is too short for this one - we'll be showing them our holdings, so the secrecy needs to last much longer. Appreciate it. Kenji (Product)
Legal purpose: Confidentiality Period - Extends the duration of confidentiality obligations beyond the standard term to align with the specific needs of the parties involved.

Disclosure of Confidential Information - Specifies the types of information that are considered confidential and subject to the extended confidentiality obligations.

Morning, Nordic Public Pension Fund, a pension fund, is committing US$50m to the flagship fund and needs a side letter. They want us barred from launching a competing fund in Indonesia for three years. Thanks in advance. Sarah (PM team)
Legal purpose: Non-solicitation of investors - prohibits competing fund launches for a fixed period

Non-compete - prohibits competing fund operations in a specific jurisdiction for a fixed period

Hi Legal, Could you prepare an NDA with Raffles Pension Trustees (a pension consultant)? We are discussing a potential seed investment in our new fund. Only we are disclosing anything here, so it should just bind them, not us. We need tighter protection: written undertakings from each recipient and a log of recipients. Allow assignment within the group without consent. Thanks! Mei Ling (IR)
Legal purpose: Written Undertakings - Ensures specific individuals agree to the terms.

Recipient Log - Maintains a record of those who have received the confidential information.

Assignment Clause - Permits transfer within a defined group without additional consent.

Hi, Atlas Fund of Funds, a fund of funds, is committing US$200m to the flagship fund and needs a side letter. Counterparty will only sign if the agreement is under the law of England and Wales. Thanks in advance. Sarah (PM team)
Legal purpose: Law of Agreement - Specifies the governing law of the agreement as England and Wales.

Morning, Could you prepare an NDA with Harbourfront Capital Pte. Ltd. (a family office)? We are discussing sharing data for a mandate pitch. They asked for a carve-out for general know-how their staff retain from memory. Counterparty will only sign if the agreement is under the law of England and Wales. Thanks! Mei Ling (IR)
Legal purpose: Carve-out for general know-how - permits the retention and use of general knowledge and expertise.

Governing Law - specifies that English law governs the agreement.

Hello team, New subscription from Clementi Holdings Pte. Ltd. (investment holding company) for about S$5m into the Asia Income Fund. Please prepare the subscription agreement. Some client personal information will be stored outside Singapore - please cover that. Notices by courier are impractical for them, email should be enough. Many thanks. Mei Ling (IR)
Legal purpose: Storage of Personal Data Outside Singapore - Allows storage of data outside Singapore with appropriate safeguards.

Acceptable Notice Method - Permits notices via email.

Morning, Evergreen University Endowment, a endowment, is committing US$25m to the flagship fund and needs a side letter. If we give better terms to another similar investor later, they want the same. They need an exclusion for thermal coal, tobacco and controversial weapons exposure. Many thanks. Mei Ling (IR)
Legal purpose: Side letter - to provide additional terms and conditions for a specific investor.

Exclusion clause - to exclude certain types of investment exposure.

Look-back provision - to ensure the investor receives the same terms if better terms are offered to another investor later.

Hi, New subscription from Mr Tan Wei Ming (individual accredited investor) for about S$20m into the Asia Income Fund. Please prepare the subscription agreement. Notices by courier are impractical for them, email should be enough. Counterparty will only sign if the agreement is under the law of England and Wales. Allow paying out redemptions in kind. Appreciate it. Priya (Sales)
Legal purpose: Subscription Agreement - Establishes the terms of the subscription
Jurisdiction Clause - Specifies the governing law as England and Wales
Redemption in Kind - Allows for the distribution of assets instead of cash

Hi, New subscription from Central Provident Staff Pension (statutory pension board) for about S$0.5m into the Asia Income Fund. Please prepare the subscription agreement. The investor is fine receiving securities instead of cash when it exits. Cheers. Kenji (Product)
Legal purpose: Subscription Clause - Allows the subscription of securities.

Exit Mechanism Clause - Specifies the method of exiting the investment.

Securities Distribution Clause - Permits the distribution of securities upon exit.

Morning, Sakura Life Insurance Co., a insurer, is committing US$200m to the flagship fund and needs a side letter. They will sign on DocuSign, so make sure that's valid. Please switch dispute resolution to litigation in Singapore instead of SIAC. They are investing because of Mr Tan, so they need protection if he stops running the strategy. Thanks! Kenji (Product)
Legal purpose: Dispute Resolution - Provides for resolution of disputes through litigation in Singapore courts.

Side Letter - Allows for additional terms not present in the main fund agreement.

Hi Legal, We won a discretionary Asian equities mandate from Temasek Road Endowment, a university endowment, roughly S$120m. Please draft the IMA. Notices by courier are impractical for them, email should be enough. Investor data will be processed by their back office in Manila, so we need wording on sending personal data overseas. Many thanks. Sarah (PM team)
Legal purpose: Data Protection and Privacy - Protects the handling and transfer of personal data outside the jurisdiction.

Dispute Resolution - Specifies the methods and jurisdictions for resolving disputes.

Cross-Border Data Transfer - Allows the transfer of personal data to locations outside the jurisdiction.

Hello team, We won a discretionary Asian equities mandate from Orchard Family Office Pte. Ltd., a single-family office, roughly S$120m. Please draft the IMA. Please add a Shariah compliance undertaking. Cap the gross exposure we can take on their account. We should limit how much we can be on the hook for - roughly a year of fees. If our lead PM leaves they want to be told quickly and be able to walk away. Appreciate it. Arjun (Distribution)
Legal purpose: Shariah Compliance Undertaking - Ensures compliance with Islamic law principles.

Gross Exposure Cap - Limits the maximum risk exposure.

Fees Indemnity - Caps liability to a year's worth of fees.

Confidential Information - Protects sensitive information shared between parties.

Non-solicitation of Employees - Prohibits poaching staff for a fixed period.

Termination for Cause - Allows for immediate termination in case of breach.

Right to Terminate - Grants the right to end the agreement early.
